sloka: तच्चाप्यहं बलं सर्वं तं च राक्षसपुङ्गवम् ।नष्टौजसं रणे कृत्वा परं हर्षमुपागमम् ।। ५.५८.१२६ ।।।।
transliteration: taccāpyahaṁ balaṁ sarvaṁ taṁ ca rākṣasapuṅgavam ।naṣṭaujasaṁ raṇe kṛtvā paraṁ harṣamupāgamam ।। 5.58.126 ।।।।

translations.english: "When the army and even the Generals were done to death in combat I was very happy.
